## What this manual is for

Use this manual for exact menus, parameters, files, checks, failure conditions
and recovery procedures. Operational responsibility and retained evidence
belong in the [Operations Manual](../operations/index.qmd); statistical meaning
and interpretation belong in the [Public Methods Manual](../methods/index.qmd).

## Architecture

| Layer | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| **REDCap and controlled sources** | Hold authoritative confidential records. |
| **Stata** | Prepare analytical inputs, calculate statistics, apply publication controls and promote approved public packages. |
| **Quarto** | Present approved public outputs without becoming a parallel analytical workflow. |
| **GitHub** | Version and deploy the static, public-safe Info-Hub. |

Private data, staging packages, credentials, logs and review evidence remain
outside Git. Generated outputs are corrected only through source data or
version-controlled code and a rerun.

## Implemented analytical routes

- [CVD event release](workflows/cvd-events/overview.qmd): separate six-step workflow.
- [CVD mortality release](workflows/mortality/overview.qmd): separate six-step workflow.
- [Rolling three-month update](workflows/reporting/rolling-update.qmd): one controlled build from approved standard releases.
- [Annual CVD report](workflows/reporting/annual-report.qmd): build, approve and publish.
- [One-off CVD report](workflows/reporting/one-off-report.qmd): prepare, approve and publish.

## Publication and maintenance

- [Review an analytical release](controls/review-release.qmd)
- [Apply disclosure control](controls/disclosure-control.qmd)
- [Approve and publish a release](controls/approve-publish.qmd)
- [Maintain public CVD tables](website/cvd-tables.qmd)
- [Render and publish the website](website/render-publish.qmd)
- [Make a safe code change](maintenance/safe-code-change.qmd)
- [Fix common problems](maintenance/troubleshooting.qmd)

Public tables, dashboards, downloads and reports reuse approved public metric
releases wherever their purpose permits. New presentation components must not
establish a second calculation or approval route.
